name: Train all major muscle groups at least twice weekly
description: ACSM's 2026 position stand emphasizes training all major muscle groups at least twice weekly and individualizing programs around goals and adherence.
explanation: Never optimize one day in isolation; a rolling weekly stimulus ledger is required to see whether every major muscle group is actually receiving regular training.

name: ~10 weekly sets per muscle group is a practical hypertrophy anchor
description: ACSM's 2026 guidance highlights approximately 10 weekly sets per muscle group as a practical hypertrophy target.
explanation: This is a starting anchor, not an immutable prescription. It must not itself drive today's workout; it is a reference/default value only, superseded by Tier 4 personal history once available.

name: Personalized history should calibrate, not be replaced by, generic volume formulas
description: Barbell Medicine recommends beginning near volumes the individual has previously tolerated and progressed on, then adjusting according to performance and fatigue.
explanation: Historical successful sessions should be the default dose anchor once enough personal data exists; generic guidance only initializes the model.
